title: Handley Page Halifax LK878
memorial_details:
description: Large, vaguely rectangular, moss-covered stone with a black, rectangular plaque upper-centre of the front face.  The dedication is in white, upper-case letters.  Two rectangular planters/troughs stand in front of the stone containing twisted pieces of metal (presumably from the crashed Halifax).

This crash is also commemorated at St Felix Church, Felixkirk (see 102083)
